title: Scheduling Desk Reference: Virtual Care Booking Windows, Reschedule Allowance and Reminders
content:
For Virtual Care, five figures govern the calendar of a scheduled visit: how far ahead it may be booked, the minimum lead time between booking and start, how many times the patient may reschedule it, and when the reminder and the connection test link are sent.

## Definitions

- **Booking horizon** — the furthest day ahead a scheduled virtual visit may be booked, in days. A value of 0 means the visit type is not schedulable.
- **Minimum booking lead** — the minimum number of minutes between booking and the start of the visit.
- **Reschedule allowance** — the maximum number of patient reschedules of one scheduled virtual visit.
- **Reminder** — the number of hours before a scheduled start at which the reminder is sent. A value of 0 means no reminder is sent.
- **Connection test link** — the number of hours before a scheduled start at which the connection test link is sent. A value of 0 means no link is sent.

## Figures by visit type

| Visit type | Booking horizon | Minimum booking lead | Reschedule allowance | Reminder | Connection test link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 0 days (not schedulable) | 0 minutes | 0 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 30 days | 60 minutes | 2 | 24 hours before | 0 (none) |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 60 days | 60 minutes | 2 | 24 hours before | 24 hours before |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 90 days | 1440 minutes | 2 | 48 hours before | 24 hours before |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 90 days | 1440 minutes | 2 | 24 hours before | 24 hours before |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 0 days (not schedulable) | 0 minutes | 0 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) |

## The lead times in hours

The minimum booking lead is set in minutes. Expressed in hours, 60 minutes is one hour and 1440 minutes is 24 hours:

| Visit type | Minimum booking lead in minutes | The same lead in hours |
|---|---|---|
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 60 | 1 |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 60 | 1 |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 1440 | 24 |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 1440 | 24 |

## Notes

- The Portal E-Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carry a booking horizon of 0 days: neither is a schedulable visit type, and both show 0 for every other figure on this page.
- The Audio-Only Phone Visit receives a reminder but no connection test link; the three video visit types that are schedulable receive both.
- The Behavioral Health Video Visit is the one visit type whose reminder goes out 48 hours before the start.
